title: docs + skill: teach `os environments use-runtime` and the self-hosted `os deploy` target (follow-up owed by #30888 / PR #31137)
body:
domain:server#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dLQEXWGsE2SZ3Qn5F

Filing gate: **① a named location** — a follow-up owed by landed work (#30888, PR #31137). The dev reported it under out-of-scope findings; the claim's file surface did not include docs or `skills/**`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

#30888 新增了 `os environments use-runtime 地址 --token 密钥`：记住一个私有部署的运行时（Docker 社区版或企业版），之后 `os deploy` 和 `os dev` 里的 `d` 键直接部署到它，`os package install` 不写 `-u`/`-t` 时也用它。文档和平台技能还没写这些，开发者和 AI 助手读不到，只能继续手敲地址和令牌。

## Where

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` — the `os environments` and `os deploy` sections (both already name `os environments switch`).
- `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx` — the deploy loop page names only the cloud target.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` — the deploy/publish operations reference (and its evals in `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` if a case covers the deploy target).

## Expected

- Document the command (`<url> --token <key>`, `--no-verify`, `--forget`), where it is stored (`~/.objectstack/cloud.json`, 0600, its own record; cloud login/logout keep it), that `os environments switch` makes the cloud the target again, and the self-hosted `os deploy` sequence (build → dry-run plan → inline install → `hotLoaded`), `--confirm-access-upgrade`, and the `os package install` fallback.
- Every sentence is checked against the merged code (`packages/cli/src/commands/environments/use-runtime.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/runtime-target.ts`).
- Reader: the lane that owns docs and `skills/**` after triage; it runs once PR #31137 is merged.

Dedupe (2026-11-07, open and closed): `"environments use-runtime" is:issue` → 1 hit (#30888 itself); `self-hosted deploy docs is:issue is:open` → 10 hits, #26688 (deployment docs, developer half) is the nearest and does not cover this command; the rest are epics, QA runs and seat posts.

Suggested-grade: p3 · docs/skill drift for a new CLI command.
